build_graph_attention_block: build a GraphAttentionBlock module with global, molecular graph, GNN, and regularization configs for graph neural networks
run_graph_attention_block_forward: run the GraphAttentionBlock forward pass with GraphAttentionData and neighbor representations to get updated neighbor reps
build_feed_forward_network: build a FeedForwardNetwork module with residual scaling, normalization, and dropout for graph neural network layers
run_feed_forward_network_forward: run the FeedForwardNetwork forward pass on a tensor to apply normalized feed-forward transformation with residual connection
